title: Passwordless login with magic link
description: Implement passwordless login using a one-use magic link token and user feedback states.
constraints: No real email provider is introduced.
No infrastructure outside the feature scope is modified.
Token behavior remains deterministic for the mock benchmark.
acceptanceCriteria: The user can request a magic link from a login screen.
The system generates a one-use token.
The token expires and cannot be reused.
The callback validates the token and creates a session.
The UI shows success and error feedback.
Focused tests cover success, expiry and invalid token cases.
expectedConflictNotes: Token model and request/callback behavior may compete for the same auth contract.
Tests depend on both backend and UI behavior.
